key_highlights: ASX 200 (^AXJO) recovered from early session declines to close higher, demonstrating resilience against Wall Street volatility.
ANZ Group (ANZ.AX) reported a full-year profit of $7.6b, but warned of expanding 90+ day home loan delinquency rates.
Severe Australian housing market correction and RBA restrictive rates continue to squeeze household budgets and borrowing capacity.
Australian dollar (AUD/USD) faces sharp downward pressure, elevating imported inflation risks while supporting USD offshore earners.
Resource activity shows divergence with iron ore prices under pressure while gold exploration and Beetaloo gas projects advance.

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings offset by rising mortgage arrears and household credit stress under restrictive RBA policy.
sectors.implications: Net interest margins peak while loan impairment provisions risk ticking upward across major banks (ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX).

sectors.trend: Bulk commodities (iron ore) face persistent demand headwinds, while junior exploration in gold, scandium, and gallium accelerates.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face free cash flow moderation; selective capital flows toward gold and critical mineral developers.

sectors.trend: Crude oil recovery remains sluggish, but domestic gas security advances with key NT Beetaloo Basin production licensing.
sectors.implications: Supports long-term asset value for domestic gas producers (STO.AX) and junior developers amidst East Coast gas shortfalls.

sectors.trend: National dwelling values endure sharp declines while regional mall landlords face department store tenant downsizing.
sectors.implications: Retail REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) face tenant remixing costs and cap rate expansion in high-interest rate climate.

sectors.trend: Accelerating data centre capacity requirements clash with power grid constraints and community pushback.
sectors.implications: Operators and infrastructure owners (NXT.AX, GMG.AX) face potential delays and rising connection costs.

key_themes: Monetary policy transmission lag accelerating mortgage distress and national housing deflation
AUD weakness generating margin squeeze for domestic importers but boosting offshore revenue translation
Grid capacity bottlenecks impacting artificial intelligence and data infrastructure development
Divergence between defensive balance sheets and consumer-exposed discretionary sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Escalating Mortgage Arrears and Bank Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight sub-prime and high-LVR mortgage exposures; prioritize banks with superior provisioning buffers and Tier-1 capital ratios.
Increase asset allocation to global USD revenue generators (CSL.AX, COH.AX) and currency-hedged overseas equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Mall Structural Disruption and Consumer Retrenchment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to discretionary retail landlords; favor non-discretionary convenience and logistics assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data Centre Grid Access Moratoriums and Delays
risk_assessment.mitigation: Focus on developers with secured grid connection agreements and off-grid renewable power purchase agreements.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight high-quality offshore healthcare and industrials with USD earnings exposure.
opportunities.rationale: Severe AUD depreciation provides significant FX translation tailwinds insulated from domestic mortgage stress.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate low-cost gold producers with expanding reserve bases.
opportunities.rationale: High-grade discoveries and gold price resilience offer reliable hedging against currency weakness and equity volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in strategic domestic onshore gas infrastructure developers.
opportunities.rationale: Key NT licensing milestones derisk upstream commercialisation amid persistent domestic supply shortages.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim cyclical consumer discretionary retailers ahead of margin-dilutive holiday discounting.
defensive_moves.rationale: Household disposable income contraction and mortgage debt service pressures constrain non-essential spending.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement index downside protection and underweight rate-sensitive bank credit.
defensive_moves.rationale: Record housing price declines and climbing arrears point to elevated provisioning and multiple derating risks.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 expected to trade range-bound (8,100–8,350) as resilient corporate profits battle surging mortgage stress and weak consumer sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Broader index returns remain constrained by housing deflation and RBA hawkishness; outperformance centered on export earners and energy infrastructure.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and monetary policy statements
Quarterly Australian CPI and wage price indices
FY26 major bank earnings updates and loan loss provisioning metrics
China property sector policy announcements and iron ore import demand
Australian domestic energy and power grid planning directives
watch_list: Australian major banks 90+ day home loan delinquency rates
Spot iron ore (62% Fe CFR Qingdao) prices
Global equity market volatility and US Treasury yields
